title: SUMtv Sabbath School Hour
description: Our weekly Sabbath School Hour is deisgned to help you strengthen your understanding of God's word as we go through the quarterly Sabbath School Lessons together.

title: SUMtv Worship Hour
description: SUMtv Worship Hour is a weekly series that features a variety of speakers who earnestly present deep, edifying sermons based on the Word of God. Each sermon offers a different message using biblical prophecy, Christian doctrine, the present truth, practical Christian living, and biblical teachings through the lens of history. Tune in to find encouragement for strengthening your faith, renewing your spirit and living in harmony with God's will.

title: The Better Way
description: Thinking about getting married but feeling discouraged by the current state of society? This series presented by Pastor Octavian Poenaru may offer some reassurance that with God's leading, healthy relationships can last and even be restored. Learn the short and long-term negative effects of marital conflicts, the main predisposing factor for conflicts and how to develop a strategy for solving them.

title: Mind Wars - Eric Walsh
description: In this three-part series, Eric Walsh exposes Satan’s attempts to distract us from the soon return of Jesus Christ through his subtle threats upon our generation. Though especially aimed at young people, this series offers a warning relevant to all ages.

title: Anchor 2024: The Great Prophecies of the Old Testament Part II
description:
Anchor is a seminary-level course of study on the fundamentals of Seventh-day Adventist theology, taught by Pastor Stephen Bohr. The mission of ANCHOR is to settle students into the Truth both intellectually and spiritually and provide the theological skills to share with others the reason for the hope that is in them.
Will your anchor hold in the coming storm?

title: Equipping The Saints
description: The church was never intended to be merely a social club for members but a training school for missionaries. This eye-opening series presented by Kameron Devasher will reveal God's original design for His people to be personally active in giving the gospel to the world, winning souls for His kingdom, and hastening the return of Jesus.

title: The 24 Elders
description: There has been much discussion in the Seventh-day Adventist church about the identity of the 24 elders. Some believe that they represent those who resurrected with Jesus. Others believe that they are the highest of angels. Who is this select group and what is their function in the heavenly courts? What lessons do they teach us regarding God's mode of operating the universe? These and other questions are clearly answered in this ground-breaking series.

title: Misinterpreted Texts on the State of the Dead
description: We live in a world captivated by the supernatural. Spiritualism has deeply influenced our media and entertainment. But what does the Bible actually teach about the state of the dead? Does the soul depart from the body at death? Are the righteous in heaven praising God? Are the wicked currently suffering in hell? In this enlightening series, Pastor Stephen Bohr explores these vital questions and more, offering clear, biblical answers about death and the afterlife.

title: Silencing Satan
description: Humanity has witnessed Satan’s relentless attempts to bring about destruction. In the face of such pervasive evil, sincere questions naturally arise - questions that may cause people to doubt God’s power, love, or even His very existence. This series confronts those challenging questions head-on, offering faith-affirming answers straight from God’s Word. Through hope and truth Satan can be silenced.

title: The Best of I'd Like to Know
description: The Best of I'd Like to Know revisits some of the series’ most compelling questions about the Bible, faith, and Christian life. Through Scripture-based answers and thoughtful discussion, these selected episodes invite you to discover timeless biblical truths, and deepen your understanding of God’s Word.

description: Have you found yourself wondering: What is going on in this world? If God is good how can he allow pain and injustice? In the limited understanding and infinite corruption of the world, we do not find answers that satisfy our souls. Only in God's Word and through the messages of Revelation can we find understanding, hope and peace.

description: Satan has sought to counterfeit God’s intimate gifts with self-centered indulgences, and sadly many have fallen for the deception. One of God’s most intimate gifts, sex, was created to foster deep connection within the covenant of marriage between a man and a woman. So how can we overcome sinful desires that go against His design? Not by our own strength, but by surrendering our thoughts to Jesus and allowing the Holy Spirit to transform our hearts.

We hope you find encouragment to embrace every health journey with faith and reverence.

description: Before Jesus came to this earth, He sat down with His Father and planned the seven successive steps that He would take in the plan of salvation. Follow along as we travel around the world looking for clues and evidence about God.

This series, featuring many educated hosts, presents step-by-step demonstrations for delicious vegetarian/vegan recipes that will help you enjoy your food and live well!
